name: Rogueflite Extraction
summary:
ROGUEFLITE Extraction is a single-player extraction roguelite where every action makes the journey home more dangerous.

Explore an abandoned facility, using physics and elemental interactions to uncover alternate routes. Reactivate dormant systems for greater rewards, but increased overall difficulty. Push too deep and you may not survive the return journey.

Exploit the world. It adapts. Extract if you can.
